subject: Request: SP role attestation & cross-state dataflow diagram
messages:
From: S. Thompson <sthomp@acmehealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legalops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SP role attestation & cross-state dataflow diagram

Maya —

Thanks for taking this. As part of AcmeHealth's vendor onboarding for our 2027 rollout we need a short attestation that Redwood Inference operates as a Service Provider under CCPA/CPRA (i.e., does not act as a Seller) and confirmation of any cross-state dataflows for telemetry/operational logs. Specifically we need:

- A one-paragraph attestation we can include in our vendor file.
- A diagram of dataflows showing where telemetry or aggregated metrics might traverse state lines (US states) or leave the US.
- A yes/no on whether any subprocessors operate in Canada/EU (we have a harder review path if they do).
- Any supporting artifacts (e.g., subprocessor list, onshore-fallback options, SOC2 cert references).

Can you get this to us by EOD Monday (Nov 2)? If you need a template, I attached our checklist.

Appreciate it —
Sam Thompson
Director of Privacy, AcmeHealth
sthomp@acmehealth.com

Attachment: acme_privacy_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet with checklist)

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: S. Thompson <sthomp@acmehealth.com>, Legal Ops <legalops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: SP role attestation & cross-state dataflow diagram

Naomi / Aditya —

Forwarding Acme's ask. They want a brief SP attestation and a dataflow diagram focusing on telemetry, aggregate metrics, and any cross-state routing or international hops. They also want to know if any subprocessors are present in Canada/EU.

I've attached their checklist and a blank dataflow template (state-dataflow-template_v1.pdf). Can we:

1) Draft a one-paragraph attestation suitable for Legal Ops to include in Acme's file.
2) Produce a dataflow diagram (PDF) that marks where telemetry and aggregated logs travel, and highlight any third-party subprocessors (by country).
3) Confirm a short list of subprocessors relevant to telemetry/export (e.g., CDN, monitoring, caching).

Timeline: EOD Monday Nov 2 if possible. If we can't meet that, please propose the earliest alternative.

Thanks —
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.com

Attachments: acme_privacy_checklist.xlsx, state-dataflow-template_v1.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: S. Thompson <sthomp@acmehealth.com>, Legal Ops <legalops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SP role attestation & cross-state dataflow diagram

Maya —

Draft attestation below (feel free to iterate). I kept it concise so it slots into Acme's vendor file easily. Notes after the paragraph.

---
Redwood Inference attestation (draft):
Redwood Inference, Inc. ("Redwood") confirms that for AcmeHealth's use case Redwood acts as a Service Provider under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) / California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) and comparable U.S. state privacy laws. Redwood processes personal information strictly on behalf of, and under the documented instructions of, AcmeHealth and does not collect personal information for independent commercial purposes or disclose personal information for cross-contextual advertising. Where applicable, Redwood's subprocessors are engaged to provide operational services (hosting, caching, telemetry aggregation) and are contractually bound to process data only in accordance with Redwood's DPA and documented security controls.
---

Clarifications / supporting points:
- Subprocessors: We will include a current subprocessor list. At a high level: cloud compute (AWS), telemetry aggregator (MetricStream Inc. — US-based), CDN/edge caching (EdgeServe — operates US + Canada), optional monitoring vendor (LogProbe — US). EdgeServe has Canadian infra; that is the only named subprocessor with a presence in Canada. We do NOT have active subprocessors based in the EU for Acme's typical hosted deployment.
- Cross-state flows: Primary control plane and telemetry routing originates in US regions. Certain aggregated telemetry (high-level metrics, no raw conversation text) may traverse between US regions for aggregation/HA; diagram will show common routes (us-west -> us-east). We will flag where EdgeServe's edge nodes in Canada could touch minimal telemetry (cache keys/aggregates).
- Onshore fallback: We can offer an onshore-only telemetry routing option (configurable; adds latency/cost). If Acme wants strict US-only residency, we'll propose a configuration and timeline.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II summary, subprocessor roster, the requested diagram.

I'll attach an attestation doc and a suggested diagram once Aditya confirms the tech points.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Attachment: attestation_draft.docx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: S. Thompson <sthomp@acmehealth.com>, Legal Ops <legalops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SP role attestation & cross-state dataflow diagram

Team —

Technical notes to include in the diagram and final response:

- Telemetry scope: We will only surface aggregate telemetry (counts, latencies, model-level metrics). RAW prompts/outputs are not included in telemetry exports by default; those remain in encrypted KV stores and are only accessible under explicit customer support workflows.
- Routing: For hosted deployments we maintain regional ingestion endpoints; typical flow for Acme (us-west customers) would be us-west ingestion -> us-west processing -> us-east aggregation for global metrics. We'll mark those arrows on the diagram.
- Subprocessors: EdgeServe (edge caching/CDN) operates nodes in CA (Canada) and multiple US states. EdgeServe only sees cache keys and opaque identifiers; it does not receive raw request payloads. MetricStream is US-only.
- Proposed artifacts: dataflow_diagram_v1.pdf (attached) and a short matrix mapping data elements (telemetry, aggregates, logs) to residency and retention.

I'll upload the diagram to the shared drive and attach a PDF. If Acme needs a strict US-only configuration, that requires switching EdgeServe for an onshore-only CDN option (we have a partner, US-Edge, and can provide an estimate).

Aditya Rao
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachment: dataflow_diagram_v1.pdf
Shared link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0BXiAcme/dataflow_diagram_v1

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: S. Thompson <sthomp@acmehealth.com>, Legal Ops <legalops@acmehealth.com>, AcmeHealth Privacy Team <privacy@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SP role attestation & cross-state dataflow diagram

Sam / Acme team —

Thanks for the patience. Attached are the items you requested: (1) short attestation paragraph, (2) a state-level dataflow diagram showing where telemetry aggregates may traverse US regions and the optional Canadian edge node, (3) current subprocessor roster excerpt, and (4) a matrix mapping telemetry elements to residency/retention.

Quick summary:
- Attestation: Attached (one paragraph) confirming Redwood acts as a Service Provider under CCPA/CPRA and processes data per Acme's instructions.
- Cross-state flows: Aggregated metrics may flow between US regions (us-west <-> us-east) for HA and analytics. No raw conversation text is transferred to third-party subprocessors.
- Subprocessors in Canada/EU: EdgeServe operates nodes in Canada (limited cache exposure). No EU-based subprocessors are used for default hosted deployments for Acme.
- Onshore option: If you require strict US-only residency, we can provision an onshore-only telemetry path (additional cost/time).

Please find the attachments and let us know if you'd like a redlined attestation or a formal letter on Redwood letterhead. If this looks good, we can follow up with SOC 2 evidence and our full subprocessor CSV.

Best —
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.com

Attachments: attestation_draft.docx, dataflow_diagram_v1.pdf, subprocessor_roster_excerpt.csv
